audit.why: Karma's W is a flat 12s tether — that is a short window, and telling the player to wait it out without saying how long invites a passive lane. Ragnarok (100/90/80s) blanking the root is the decisive interaction and is correctly stated already.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d and phases[4].why now carry the 12s tether and the 40s Mantra so the timing advice is concrete. Line-of-sight break to snap the tether kept — it is in Riot's text ('if the tether is not broken').

audit.why: Focused Resolve is correctly named as the matchup-defining cooldown throughout.
